creator: taki.gpt
title: Pitch for 'Prompt Master' (nidhinjs/prompt-master, ~11-13.7k GitHub stars): a free skill that rewrites messy prompts, asks clarifying questions, routes to a per-tool framework and claims to stop token waste

tools.name: Prompt Master
tools.detail: GitHub nidhinjs/prompt-master (SKILL.md, README.md, references/); shown as 13.7k stars on screen, '11,000 stars' in speech; installed via Claude > Customize > Skills > Upload a skill (prompt-master-main.zip)

claims: Extracts '9 dimensions of intent', asks targeted clarifying questions, routes to the right framework per tool (Claude Code -> ReAct + Stop Conditions; Cursor -> File-Scope; Midjourney -> Visual Descriptor; ComfyUI -> node workflow)
Checks against '35 known ways' models waste credits and remembers so it never repeats
'Without it: 3 wasted calls (Attempt 1-4); with Prompt Master: first try' -- 'zero wasted tokens'
how_to_steps: Download the prompt-master repo zip from GitHub
Claude.ai > Settings/Customize > Skills > Upload a skill > select zip
Toggle it on; paste any messy prompt and it reformats it with clarifying questions
on_screen_only: 'How to never hit your AI token limits again!' title
GitHub repo nidhinjs / prompt-master, Public, files: references/, README.md, SKILL.md; 'prompt-master-main.zip'; '13.7k stars on GitHub'
Example: 'Write me a midjourney prompt for a realistic samurai standing in the rain at night' -> 'Prompt Master is formatting...'
Clarifying question UI: 'Who is this for?' 1/3
Routing table: Claude Code -> ReAct + Stop Conditions (optimized), Cursor -> File-Scope (optimized), Midjourney -> Visual Descriptor, ComfyUI -> ComfyUI node workflow
'It remembers, so it never repeats: "continue where we left off"'

Output card: 'Target: Claude Code . Tokens: Medium (~380) . Objective: Build a fully detailed, production-quality static landing page for a business dashboard product. Stack: Single HTML file with embedded CSS and vanilla JS. No frameworks. Done When: All 8 sections render correctly at both breakpoints; Opens in browser with zero console errors'
'Comment School to get the full guide and course to optimize your AI setup'
cta: comment 'school' for link + install guide; follow

relevance.why: A prompt-reformatting skill adds a round-trip to every task; for someone who already writes skills and plans, it is overhead. The 'Done When' / stop-conditions output format is the only interesting bit

implement_score.why: Skip as a default skill. Possibly borrow its 'Objective / Stack / Done When' brief format for ad-hoc Claude Code tasks. The token-savings claim is marketing

verify: Does nidhinjs/prompt-master really have 11-13.7k stars and is it maintained?
Does the clarifying-question round trip cost more tokens than it saves?
'35 known ways models waste credits' -- is that list in the repo?
Creator funnels to a paid 'school' course

gap.what: New repo name: nidhinjs/prompt-master (prompt-rewriter skill). Liked set covers token-saving skills (caveman, ponytail, Unlazy) but not a prompt-rewriting/clarifying skill. Low value though
